name: Sasebo Naval Port Cruise

en.name: Sasebo Naval Port Cruise
en.description: A 50-minute harbour cruise departing from Sasebo Port offering close-up views of Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force vessels and US Navy ships docked at the Sasebo Naval Base. Narration describes the history and role of the joint naval facilities. A rare opportunity to see active warships at close range.
highlights: Close-up views of active naval warships
Guided narration on the port's naval history
en.openingHours: Cruises depart daily 10:00–16:00 (approximately hourly). Closed during bad weather and certain base events.

ja.name: 佐世保軍港クルーズ
ja.description: 佐世保港を出港する約50分の軍港クルーズ。海上自衛隊とアメリカ海軍の艦船が停泊する佐世保基地を間近に見学できます。ガイドによる共同海軍施設の歴史と役割の解説付き。現役の艦船を間近に見られる貴重な機会です。
highlights: ガイドによる佐世保軍港の歴史解説
ja.openingHours: 毎日10:00～16:00発（約1時間毎）。荒天時・基地行事時は運休。
